<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: WPAI Publishing Starter
 * Description: Exposes editorial metrics via REST (/wpai/v1/editorial-summary) and WordPress Abilities API (wpai/editorial-summary).
 * Version: 1.0.0
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

function wpai_get_editorial_summary(): array {
	$post_counts = wp_count_posts( 'post' );
	$categories  = get_categories( array( 'hide_empty' => false ) );
	$users       = get_users( array( 'fields' => array( 'ID', 'user_login', 'display_name' ) ) );

	$cat_list = array();
	foreach ( $categories as $cat ) {
		if ( 'uncategorized' === $cat->slug ) {
			continue;
		}
		$cat_list[] = array(
			'slug'  => $cat->slug,
			'name'  => $cat->name,
			'count' => (int) $cat->count,
		);
	}

	$team = array();
	foreach ( $users as $user ) {
		$user_obj = get_userdata( (int) $user->ID );
		$team[]   = array(
			'login'        => $user->user_login,
			'display_name' => $user->display_name,
			'roles'        => $user_obj ? array_values( (array) $user_obj->roles ) : array(),
		);
	}

	return array(
		'publication'     => get_bloginfo( 'name' ),
		'published_posts' => isset( $post_counts->publish ) ? (int) $post_counts->publish : 0,
		'categories'      => $cat_list,
		'editorial_team'  => $team,
	);
}

add_action(
	'rest_api_init',
	static function (): void {
		register_rest_route(
			'wpai/v1',
			'/editorial-summary',
			array(
				'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::READABLE,
				'callback'            => static function (): WP_REST_Response {
					return new WP_REST_Response( wpai_get_editorial_summary(), 200 );
				},
				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
			)
		);
	}
);

add_action(
	'wp_abilities_api_categories_init',
	static function (): void {
		if ( function_exists( 'wp_register_ability_category' ) ) {
			wp_register_ability_category(
				'wpai',
				array(
					'label'       => 'WPAI Site Capabilities',
					'description' => 'Structured WordPress site abilities registered by WPAI starter blueprints.',
				)
			);
		}
	}
);

add_action(
	'wp_abilities_api_init',
	static function (): void {
		if ( function_exists( 'wp_register_ability' ) && function_exists( 'wp_register_ability_category' ) ) {
			wp_register_ability(
				'wpai/editorial-summary',
				array(
					'label'               => 'Editorial Summary',
					'description'         => 'Returns published article counts, newsroom categories, and editorial team roles.',
					'category'            => 'wpai',
					'input_schema'        => array(
						'type'                 => 'object',
						'properties'           => array(),
						'additionalProperties' => false,
					),
					'output_schema'       => array(
						'type'       => 'object',
						'properties' => array(
							'publication'     => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
							'published_posts' => array( 'type' => 'integer' ),
							'categories'      => array( 'type' => 'array' ),
							'editorial_team'  => array( 'type' => 'array' ),
						),
					),
					'execute_callback'    => static function (): array {
						return wpai_get_editorial_summary();
					},
					'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
					'meta'                => array(
						'annotations'  => array(
							'readonly' => true,
						),
						'show_in_rest' => true,
					),
				)
			);
		}
	}
);
